executive_summary: CamAudit reviewed 2 discovered host(s), 1 camera candidate(s), and 5 finding(s) within the authorized scope. No unauthenticated camera feed access was confirmed.

network_context.note: Sanitized demo context; no live network commands are run in demo mode.

reasons: Port 8800 returned a CSeq/RTSP-like response in sanitized lab evidence
Open TCP/443 and TCP/8443 local HTTPS services

fingerprinting_results.evidence: HTTPS JSON API returned 404/405-style behavior to safe header/root checks; no response body or feed was stored.
TPRI-DEVICE self-signed TLS certificate observed with RSA 1024-bit public key.
Port 8800 returned a CSeq header / RTSP-like response to a safe OPTIONS-style probe.

protocol_findings.title: RTSP standard ports closed
protocol_findings.evidence: TCP/554 and TCP/8554 were not reported open.
protocol_findings.explanation: Standard RTSP feed paths were not exposed during the sanitized lab audit.

protocol_findings.title: UPnP/ONVIF/mDNS not observed
protocol_findings.evidence: UDP/1900, UDP/3702, and UDP/5353 were closed or not observed in sanitized evidence.
protocol_findings.explanation: Common local discovery protocols did not produce exposed camera discovery evidence.

protocol_findings.title: Port 8800 CSeq / RTSP-like response
protocol_findings.evidence: TCP/8800 returned a CSeq header in sanitized lab evidence.
protocol_findings.explanation: The response suggests an RTSP-like or proprietary camera protocol, but no feed access was confirmed.

tls_findings.title: Weak self-signed local TLS certificate
tls_findings.evidence: TPRI-DEVICE self-signed certificate with RSA 1024-bit public key.
tls_findings.explanation: The local service uses weak TLS certificate parameters, but this finding is limited to local LAN exposure in the sanitized demo.
tls_findings.remediation: Update firmware or replace the device certificate if supported.

cve_mapping.notes: No CVE claim is made from sanitized demo evidence.

findings.title: Local HTTPS JSON API reachable
findings.evidence: TCP/443 and TCP/8443 returned HTTPS JSON API 404/405-style behavior.
findings.explanation: Services are reachable locally, but no unauthenticated feed or configuration access was confirmed.
findings.remediation: Keep firmware updated and restrict camera services to trusted LAN segments.

findings.title: Weak self-signed local TLS certificate
findings.evidence: TPRI-DEVICE self-signed certificate with RSA 1024-bit public key.
findings.explanation: The local service uses weak TLS certificate parameters.
findings.remediation: Update firmware or replace the device certificate if supported.

findings.title: Port 8800 CSeq / RTSP-like response
findings.evidence: TCP/8800 returned a CSeq header in sanitized lab evidence.
findings.explanation: The response suggests an RTSP-like or proprietary camera protocol. No unauthenticated feed access was confirmed.
findings.remediation: Restrict access to trusted LAN segments and disable the service if it is unnecessary.

findings.title: RTSP standard ports closed
findings.evidence: TCP/554 and TCP/8554 were not reported open.
findings.explanation: Standard RTSP feed paths were not exposed during the sanitized lab audit.

findings.title: UPnP/ONVIF/mDNS not observed
findings.evidence: UDP/1900, UDP/3702, and UDP/5353 were closed or not observed in sanitized evidence.
findings.explanation: Common local discovery protocols did not produce exposed camera discovery evidence.

remediation_checklist: Keep camera services restricted to trusted LAN or IoT VLAN segments.
Disable UPnP on the router where possible.
Do not expose camera services to the internet.

evidence_appendix.notes: Headers and certificate metadata only; no feed data.

redaction_log: Full MAC addresses are reduced to OUI prefixes.
Public IPs, emails, serials, UIDs, tokens, and media filenames are redacted.
No camera feed images or video are stored in this demo.
